title: Create the immutable candidate event from the source freeze
description:
Required approval supplies only the freeze artifact ID; after authenticating it and atomically publishing the candidate handoff, the dedicated App creates exactly one candidate tag whose push starts the only candidate-production run.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Reviewer-authorized workflow_dispatch accepts one numeric freeze_artifact_id and no ref/SHA/name/URL. With actions:read, contents:read, and attestations:read it verifies the exact non-expired artifact/digest/schema/attestation and sole successful trusted freeze run/attempt, then proves the protected remote tip/tree still equal its 40-hex SHA.
- [hard] REQ-02: Before token/ref mutation, dispatch uploads one 90-day handoff/prepared artifact with freeze ID/digest and fixed ref, then App creates annotated candidate tag embedding that exact artifact ID/digest and freeze-root digest. Creator readback records its operation but is not the push run's authority.
- [hard] REQ-03: The App push run verifies event/tag/SHA/App, reads handoff ID/root digest from the annotated object, downloads that ID directly, reconciles the exact existing tag, and always uploads its own candidate-event-completed or recovery-completed artifact. That exact output ID is passed via same-run job outputs into validation, every producer, and root assembly; no completion listing/discovery occurs. All event/workflow/repository/checkout/OIDC identities must equal tag/handoff/root.
- [hard] REQ-04: This leaf changes no source or product/public channel. Fixtures cover handoff/tag/push-owned completion crashes and reject missing handoff, embedded mismatch, listing authority, human ref, conflicting/moved tag, wrong actor/environment/workflow, or downstream work without the exact push-owned completion ID. Alternate records remain non-authoritative unless explicitly selected pre-tag.

## Notes

Blast radius: one artifact-ID reviewer dispatch, one immutable candidate-handoff artifact, one candidate-tag environment approval, one short-lived App token, and one candidate ref.
